mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ohfifthlane.rpz_tbl WHERE ST_DWithin(rpz_coord, ST_MakePoint(#{userLon}, #{userLat})::geography, 500)

SELECT rpz_id, rpz_num, rpz_address, rpz_lat, rpz_lon, rpz_manage_tel, rpz_manage_name, rpz_fee, ROUND(CAST(ST_Distance(rpz_coord, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{userLon}, #{userLat}), 4326)) AS NUMERIC), 2) AS rpz_distance FROM ohfifthlane.rpz_tbl WHERE ST_DWithin(rpz_coord, ST_MakePoint(#{userLon}, #{userLat})::geography, 500)
select count(*) > 0 from ohfifthlane.rpz_tbl where rpz_num = #{rpzNum}
select rpz_id from ohfifthlane.rpz_tbl where rpz_num = #{rpzNum}
